headline: CIN @ PIT matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 4.52 at PIT 4.60, with a projected total of 9.12. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CIN +0.22, PIT +0.11), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.33, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Brady Singer has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bryan Reynolds, Brandon Lowe, Blake Dunn, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Billy Cook, JJ Bleday because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
